about_title: Who We Are & What We Do
about_subtitle: The fastest JavaScript is no JavaScript.
about_p1: At IndexFlow, we are a specialized technical SEO and web performance agency dedicated to building lightning-fast digital experiences. We focus on zero-bundle, JS-less approaches that guarantee maximum performance and optimal search engine crawling.
about_p2: Our proprietary architecture ensures that your public-facing pages achieve perfect Core Web Vitals (LCP < 800ms, TBT = 0ms, CLS = 0). By offloading third-party scripts to Web Workers via Partytown, we keep the main thread completely free for your users.
about_p3: Whether you need a high-speed SvelteKit application, deep technical SEO audits, or complete Core Web Vitals excellence, our senior performance engineers are ready to transform your online presence.
srv_ext_1_desc: We build zero-JS websites by default. Only interactive modules use client-side logic, guaranteeing instantaneous load times and perfect accessibility.
srv_ext_2_desc: From Indexing API integrations to Search Console mastery, we ensure Google loves your website structure and crawls your content instantly.
srv_ext_3_desc: We integrate Google Ads, GA4, and Meta Pixel flawlessly using Partytown so tracking never blocks your page rendering or harms your Web Vitals.
cta_desc: Stop losing customers to slow load times. Let's make your website the fastest in your industry and achieve the green zone across all metrics.
